description: Grace accepts Denise Williams's request for a thirty-minute peer conversation about dual-track transition navigation. Grace provides concrete intelligence on community college retraining pathways, grant application process, CNA and NEMT certification timelines, and what the education side of a career pivot actually looks like on the ground. In return, Grace asks Denise for her read on transport infrastructure utilization trends from her position managing the parking garage — specifically how vehicle flow and occupancy patterns have shifted since RoboRide launched.

from_grace_to_denise.content: Community college retraining process, grant application specifics, CNA vs NEMT credential timeline, dual-track transition logistics from lived experience

from_denise_to_grace.content: Ground-level read on parking utilization, vehicle flow patterns, and operator behavior in Millfield since robotaxi launch
